item.description:
## Highlights
- Overshooting the configured context limit no longer rejects a request. The configured per-model context limit is now advisory: requests beyond it are served in full with no truncation or clipping, and a server-side warning records the exceedance. The model artifact's native context window remains the only hard rejection boundary, and model discovery metadata is unchanged. - The native bindings toolchain moves to bindgen 0.73.2 together with the matching syn-3 prettyplease pin, keeping the pinned MLX-C binding surface intact.
## Compatibility
- No REST API or model-discovery contract changes. Callers that previously received a context-length rejection slightly above the configured limit now receive successful generations; the hard artifact window behaves exactly as before. - No configuration changes are needed; existing context-limit values keep their meaning as the advertised advisory limit.
## Distribution
- Signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and stapled. The Sparkle update feed is signed and activated on the public appcast.
